reason: An interactive terminal UI bundle for DeepSeek Harness that provides session and workspace management, model and provider controls, agent interaction, streaming transcript display, and terminal-native panels.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供交互式终端界面，用于管理会话与工作区、选择模型和提供商，并与智能体进行流式交互。
summaries.en: An interactive terminal interface for DeepSeek Harness to manage sessions and workspaces, select models and providers, and interact with agents through streamed transcripts.

capabilities: Provides an interactive terminal user interface for DeepSeek Harness
Connects to a local or user-selected remote Web Host over HTTP or HTTPS
Creates, resumes, archives, exports, renames, forks, and reorganizes persisted sessions and workspaces
Selects models, providers, presets, permissions, settings, skills, subagents, and goals
Reads and updates provider configuration, credentials, and other settings through host services
Queues, steers, edits, and removes agent requests and can stop local standalone jobs
Admits and saves raster images through host services
Displays streaming responses, tool output, context, notifications, and approval or question prompts
